source.aggregation: Reported averages across three microservice applications

notes: Transcribed from evaluation tables; not computed from raw runs.
Each leaderboard row reports the evaluation average over three applications.
Token counts are rounded in the evaluation; expanded integers retain that approximate precision.
Null preserves a dash in the source table and must not be displayed as zero.
Marathon-Score is lifecycle-gated and cannot be recomputed by averaging aggregate Corr/Loc/Rep.
